request.query: fuel starvation uncommanded in-flight engine shutdown

answer_blocks.text: (e) Unsafe Condition This AD was prompted by a report of fuel starvation that resulted in an uncommanded in-flight engine shutdown. The FAA is issuing this AD to prevent fuel starvation. The unsafe condition, if not addressed, could result in engine power loss, engine shutdown in flight, and reduced control of the airplane.

answer_blocks.text: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain Vulcanair S.p.A. Model P.68 and P.68B airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by a report of fuel starvation that resulted in an uncommanded in-flight engine shutdown. This proposed AD would require, for certain airplanes, modification of the fuel level indicator and, for all airplanes, calibration of the fuel level indicator, installation of new quantity and warning placards, and updating the aircraft flight manual (AFM) and the aircraft maintenance manual (AMM).
